name: Nemureru Sono no Shoujo-tachi
original_name: ネムれる園の少女たち
source:
This title is the debut work for Kaeru Soft. 

Takashi is your typical guy who loves lewd things, but he’s quite gloomy and unpopular. In a bid to be popular and get to have lots of sex, he performed a ritual to summon a succubus. However, something went wrong during the summoning; an erotic curse inflicted his classmates, Rumi and Shino, and the summoned Nemu could not use her powers. Will he be able to fully enjoy his newfound life of perversion in the month before Nemu has to go back?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/12/16/december-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
本作是Kaeru Soft的出道作品。

Takashi是典型的爱淫之人，但他很阴郁，不受欢迎。为了受欢迎并获得大量性行为，他举行了召唤魅魔的仪式。然而，在召唤的过程中却出现了问题；他的同学鲁米和诗乃受到了色情诅咒，被召唤的涅姆无法使用她的力量。在尼姆必须回去之前的一个月里，他能充分享受他新发现的变态生活吗？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/12/16/december-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
